name: What defines a wellness-oriented bathroom, and how does it differ from a standard remodel?

mainEntity.name: What defines a wellness-oriented bathroom, and how does it differ from a standard remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A wellness-oriented bathroom goes beyond basic functionality, integrating features designed to promote relaxation, comfort, and well-being. This can include elements like walk-in showers with multiple spray options, freestanding soaking tubs, heated flooring, improved natural and layered lighting, and strategic material choices. Unlike a standard remodel that might focus primarily on aesthetic updates or repairing existing issues, a wellness-oriented project prioritizes creating a spa-like retreat that enhances daily routines and offers a calming experience. We consider how each element contributes to your personal sanctuary.
acceptedAnswer.description: A wellness-oriented bathroom integrates features like walk-in showers, soaking tubs, and heated floors to promote relaxation and well-being, prioritizing a spa-like experience over basic functionality.
